newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's AMP to access outside fund managers.
newsitem.headline: NZ's AMP to access outside fund managers.

text.p: AMP New Zealand said on Friday that from today its customers will have access to the products of three outside fund managers -- J.P. Morgan, BT Funds Management and ANZ Funds Management.

AMP chief manager of customer marketing Ross Baker said funds managed by the three companies would be fitted alongside existing AMP products, rather than being sold as "stand-alone" products, the New Zealand Press Association reported.
This would give customers the convenience of one customer number, one client service point and one set of fees.
The three funds were chosen from a short-list of top Australasian fund managers prepared by advisers William M. Mercer Ltd.
AMP said J.P. Morgan funds had not previously been available to New Zealand retail customers.
AMP has also been targeting the home loan market through subsidiary Ergo and through its agency force.

"Our agents are writing more home loans than ever. It's all part of our aim for AMP to be a complete financial partner for life. Home loans and investments are key parts of our strategy," said Baker. --Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
